greet.text: A lost lamb in the mist. Relax, I have already eaten today. I am Xue Yao of the Blood Lotus. Say what you want or keep walking.

choices.label: Why would anyone join the Blood Lotus?
Sell her a Blood Ginseng. (+110 stones)
Help her track a wounded mist wolf. (5 days)

why.text: The righteous sects measure your roots and throw you away. The Blood Lotus measures your will. Trash roots soaked in enough blood still blossom.

hunt.text: Ha, you didn't flinch when I drank from it. There may be hope for you yet.

kin.text: I smell it on you, the good kind of rot. A fellow traveller on the crimson road. What do you need, {player}?

choices.label: Trade 2 Blood Ginseng for a Blood Demon Pill.
Raid a herb caravan with her. (7 days)
Teach me to flee like blood on water.
Offer your own blood to her lotus seed. (burn 3 years)

raid.text: The guards ran, the drivers did not. Your share, partner. The Blood Lotus will hear your name.

teach.text: Bite your tongue, spit essence blood, and become the spray. It costs you, it always costs you. Watch.

seed.text: The lotus seed drinks and splits open. Inside, a pill of crystallised qi, your own life refined. Swallow it before it remembers what it was.

righteous.text: Azure Cloud's little hound. If you came to purge me, try it. If not, stop staring and go save a kitten.

choices.label: Urge her to leave the Blood Lotus before it consumes her.
Share your rations with her. (5 stones)

rations.text: ...Fine. They don't feed us on the outer roster. Don't tell anyone.

urge.text: She is quiet for a long time. 'And go where? Your sects wouldn't have me.' She presses a crimson token into your hand. 'If I ever run, I'll find you.'
